channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gar Forman | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gar Forman from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Gar Forman
item.description:
Wade on Forman:

“He decided to put a halt to (us speaking our mind) and hold us accountable. I have nothing but respect for him.”

Dwyane Wade on Gar Forman, Jan 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: John Paxson on Gar Forman
item.description:
“To me that’s the biggest disappointment in all of this. That falls on all of us. We put the roster together; the coaching staff and players, we’re all in this together. That’s the way it should be. Again, it goes back to responsibility and accountability for all of us. Gar (Forman, general manager) and I know we’re ultimately the ones that are responsible. Moving forward, we understand changes are going to have to be made.”

John Paxson on Gar Forman, Apr 14, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Taj Gibson on John Paxson, Gar Forman
item.description:
“I talk with Gar and Pax (Gar Forman and John Paxson) almost every other day, so I never get that feeling (of being shopped), but you never know,”

Taj Gibson on John Paxson, Gar Forman, Feb 18, 2016. Source: NBA.com.
